mpvmx.description:
mpvmx — MISHAD EDITION

A Powerful Media Player for Video and Audio

mpvmx is a feature-rich Android media player designed to deliver a smooth, flexible, and enjoyable media playback experience. Built on the open-source mpvRx project, MISHAD EDITION brings a personalized identity with a focus on usability, performance, and useful playback features.

Key Features

- Video Playback: Enjoy high-quality video playback with flexible playback controls.
- Audio Player: Play your favorite music and audio files with a dedicated audio playback experience.
- Audio Sleep Timer: Set a sleep timer directly in the audio player and let playback stop automatically after your chosen duration. Perfect for listening to music, podcasts, or other audio while falling asleep.
- Subtitle Support: Enjoy videos with subtitle support.
- Playback Controls: Manage your media playback with convenient controls.
- Personalized Experience: A customized MISHAD EDITION with its own identity and branding.

MISHAD EDITION

mpvmx is independently customized and maintained as MISHAD EDITION, based on the open-source mpvRx project.
